description:
Nakekela Ukuphepha Komndeni Wakho nge-mLite!

I-mLite uhlelo lokusebenza lokulawula lwabazali olunikeza abazali amathuluzi abawadingayo ukuvikela izingane zabo ngenkathi begcina ukuxhumana kuvulekile futhi kucacile. Inikeza izici ezibalulekile njengokulandelela indawo ebukhoma nokwabelana, amathuluzi okuphepha komndeni, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela izingane, konke kuklanywe ngezindinganiso zobumfihlo nemvume eziphezulu.

Izici Eziyinhloko ze-mLite:

📍 Ukwabelana Ngendawo Nge-GPS Ebukhoma: Bheka kalula indawo ye-GPS yengane yakho ebalazweni uma kudingeka. Lesi sici sivumela ukwabelana ngezindawo okuqondile phakathi kwamalungu omndeni, kunikeza abazali isiqinisekiso mayelana nokuthi ingane yabo ikuphi.

🗺️ Izexwayiso Zokugoba: Dala izindawo zokuphepha ezibonakalayo (ama-geofence) ebalazweni futhi uthole izexwayiso ezisheshayo uma i-GPS location tracker ithola ingane yakho ingena noma iphuma kulezi zindawo. Lokhu kukusiza ukuthi uqaphe ukunyakaza ngenkathi uhlonipha ubumfihlo bokuphepha komndeni okuthuthukisiwe.

🌐 Ukufinyelela Umlando Wendawo: Qonda amaphethini ansuku zonke engane yakho ngokubukeza ukuthi ibikuphi usuku lonke. Ukwazi imikhuba yayo kungasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isezindaweni eziphephile.

🚨 Inkinobho Ye-Alarm Ephuthumayo: Ingane yakho ingakukhombisa ngokushesha uma kukhona ingozi ngokuthepha kanye nje usebenzisa inkinobho ephuthumayo, okukuvumela ukuthi usabele ngokushesha ezimweni eziphuthumayo.

📱 Ukubuyekezwa Kohlu Lokuxhumana: Vikela ingane yakho ngokubheka ukuthi ikhuluma nobani, uqinisekise ukuthi ukuxhumana kwenzeka kuphela nabantu abathembekile ukuze kuphathwe kangcono futhi kuphathwe ukuphepha komndeni.

📩 Ukuqapha Ukuxhumana Okuphephile: Ngohlelo lokusebenza lokulawula lwabazali kanye nesivumelwano esivela enganeni, ungabheka imiyalezo eshintshaniswa ngezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuxhumana kwe-inthanethi kunomthwalo wemfanelo futhi kuphephile.

I-GPS locator mLite isebenzisa izinsizakalo zokufinyeleleka kuphela ngezinjongo zokuphepha njengokuqapha ukuxhumana kohlelo lokusebenza oluthile ngolwazi oluphelele oluvela enganeni ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuphephile ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuqoqa idatha yomuntu siqu ngaphandle kwemvume.

Izinyathelo Zokufaka:

1. Faka uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-mLite kudivayisi yakho.

2. Bhalisa njengomzali.

3. Faka i-mLite kudivayisi yengane yakho futhi.

4. Khetha "ingane" ngesikhathi sokusetha.

5. Vumela ukwabelana ngemininingwane yendawo kanye noxhumana nabo.

6. Xhuma amadivayisi ngokuskena ikhodi ye-QR noma usebenzisa isixhumanisi esenziwe ngumzali.

Ulwazi Olubalulekile: Uhlelo lokusebenza lokulawula abazali lwe-mLite luhloselwe ukusetshenziswa kuphela ezimweni lapho bobabili abantu beqaphela—imvume yabazali kanye neyengane iyadingeka ngaphambi kokufakwa okulandela imihlahlandlela ye-GDPR ngokuqinile mayelana nemikhuba yokuphatha idatha.

Izimvume Ezidingekayo:
- Ikhamera/Izithombe: Ukuxhuma amadivayisi nge-QR scan.
- Ukufinyelela Oxhumana Nabo: Ukubuyekeza uhlu loxhumana nabo ukuqinisekisa ukusebenzisana okuphephile.
- Ukusetshenziswa Kwedatha Yendawo: Ukwabelana ngendawo bukhoma nezinye izici kufaka phakathi izaziso ze-geofence.
